findings.fact: PE_state initialized/pointer tests and retaining properties are not proof of accessible immutable storage or registry publication quiescence. Whole-call trusted boot serialization/accessibility/quiescence is explicitly required. findings.fact: Expected/ops/workspace/out spans are disjoint before acquisition or scratch copy. Borrowed prefix/3data spans must avoid them and each other; size bounds are checked before access. Only40 common BootArgs bytes are copied: R2/V2, actualphys/mem/top consistency; no Video/tail/fullsizeof read. Legacy736/native1152 remain indistinguishable from this prefix. Caller-supplied identities/finalnativewire hash are not recomputed or authenticated here.

Chosen DRAM equals decoded DRAM; actual physical base/memory size equal decoded envelope; retainedboot starts at actualphys and covers nonempty [phys,top] prefix with top no greater than decoded end. Frozen decoder already bounds ranges/reservations. This validates declared format/consistency only, not actual retention, complete source coverage, RAM eligibility or bpl_policy/native owner setup.

Operations are copied before callbacks, including finish. Failed begin still receives finish. Recheck pointer/count/object differences short-circuit before byte comparisons; malformed changed pointer/SIZE_MAX count refuses safely in independent sanitizer cases. Expected identity is compared with the staged copy before cleanup. Cleanup failure disqualifies success; output commits once after known status+cleanup success. Workspace may change; accessible immutable input and trusted callback/context lifetime remain preconditions.
